## What changed?

Link the related Issue (e.g. Fixes #123) and explain the solution.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation / translation
- [ ] Tests / refactor

## Verification

- [ ] Windows unit tests: `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] Windows language test: `python test_v100_i18n.py` if relevant
- [ ] Android debug build: `gradle :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon` if relevant
- [ ] Physical Android / OBS / Discord test if relevant
- [ ] Not applicable (explain)

**Test results / device details:**

## Security, privacy and AI transparency

- [ ] No pairing keys, user configs, private media, device IDs or signing credentials.
- [ ] Video-only / local-first scope and Android camera consent preserved.
- [ ] No unverified claims of native FPS/resolution.
- [ ] Documentation and translations updated where relevant.
- [ ] Significant AI assistance disclosed, when applicable.

Redact personal details and only upload images you may share.
